name: Monday.com
description: Monday.com is a work management platform built around boards, groups, items, columns, dashboards, and automations. Teams use it to plan projects, assign work, track status and dates, and coordinate workflows across departments.
agentUseSummary: Connect a monday.com account once, then select which agents may list boards, read items and updates, prepare changes, create or update items, and add discussion updates under Safe or Dangerous policy.

capabilities.label: View boards
capabilities.description: List boards visible to the connected user.

capabilities.label: Find and read items
capabilities.description: List board items and read item details and discussion updates.

capabilities.label: Prepare item changes
capabilities.description: Prepare an exact item create, update, or comment locally.

capabilities.label: Create and update items
capabilities.description: Create items, update names or column values, and add discussion updates.

allowed.label: List boards
allowed.description: List a bounded set of boards visible to the connected user.

allowed.label: List board items
allowed.description: List a bounded first page of items from one explicit board.

allowed.label: Read an item
allowed.description: Read one explicit item with its board, group, columns, and bounded update context.

allowed.label: List item updates
allowed.description: List bounded discussion updates for one explicit item.

allowed.label: Prepare an item change
allowed.description: Prepare and hash one item create, update, or comment locally.

approvalRequired.label: Create an item
approvalRequired.description: Create one item on an explicit board; Safe mode requires matching approval.

approvalRequired.label: Update an item
approvalRequired.description: Change the name or bounded column values of one explicit item; Safe mode requires matching approval.

approvalRequired.label: Add an update
approvalRequired.description: Post one bounded discussion update to an explicit item; Safe mode requires matching approval.

blocked.label: Administer monday.com
blocked.description: Workspace, board, group, column, user, team, permission, and billing administration are outside V1.

blocked.label: Delete or bulk-change work
blocked.description: Item deletion, file mutation, webhooks, schema mutation, broad exports, and bulk changes are outside V1.

blocked.label: Call arbitrary GraphQL
blocked.description: Raw GraphQL, automatic pagination, and monday platform MCP tools are never exposed to agents.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded reads and local drafts run directly; each monday.com item write requires matching approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Every selected monday.com operation supported by this connector runs without Relay per-action approval; connection ownership, request bounds, audits, redaction, and provider limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts eight typed monday.com tools and attaches the authorized user's token server-side without exposing it to the agent.
Railway mounts eight typed monday.com tools and attaches the authorized user's token server-side without exposing it to the agent.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay Console's monday.com OAuth 2.1 application, exact production redirect URL, scopes, client credentials, live app version, and a fresh production authorization have not been configured and verified.
providerSetup.nextAction: Create a monday.com app, enable the new OAuth flow, register https://api.relayconsole.work/api/v1/marketplace/oauth/monday-com/callback, grant the seven declared scopes, add MONDAY_CLIENT_ID and MONDAY_CLIENT_SECRET to Railway, promote the tested app version live, then verify PKCE, account binding, token rotation and revocation, bounded reads, Safe writes, Dangerous writes, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Monday.com documents its OAuth 2.1 token endpoint, required S256 PKCE, expiring access tokens, rotating refresh tokens, six-month maximum lifetime, and revocation endpoint.
Monday.com documents the authorization endpoint, exact redirect URL matching, state, account selection, and the declared account, workspace, board, and update scopes.
Monday.com identifies 2026-04 as the stable current production API version and recommends sending the API-Version header.
Monday.com documents bounded board queries and board groups, columns, workspaces, item counts, and items_page.
Monday.com documents explicit item reads, create_item, and JSON column values.
Monday.com documents reading updates and posting one create_update mutation.
Monday.com requires tokens in the Authorization header and limits app tokens by both user permissions and app scopes.
